subject: CloudRelay — AWS co-sell registration & PDM/PSM introductions
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudrelay.com>, Luke Porter <luke@cloudrelay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudRelay — AWS co-sell registration & PDM/PSM introductions

Hi Samira / Luke,

Great chatting earlier this week. Per our call, CloudRelay looks like a solid fit for an AWS co-sell (ACE) motion — you're running LLM-based ingestion for telemetry enrichment and want predictable latency/cost at scale, which maps well to Redwood's Dedicated + private routing story.

Next asks to move this to ACE intake:
- Can you confirm the primary contact (name, email) who will accept the ACE registration?
- Can you share the current procurement stage (PO, SOW, legal review)?
- Please see the attached opportunity brief for our recommended co-sell positioning and the technical summary (attachment: CloudRelay-Opportunity-Brief.pdf).

If you're comfortable, I'd like to loop in the AWS PDM/PSM for a short 30-min sync this week to get them to assign a co-sell lead and confirm the registration steps. Laura, Aditya — please help us: Aditya to prepare the ACE registration packet, Laura to line up PDM intro availability.

Proposed times for intro call:
- Wed 6/21 09:00-09:30 PT
- Wed 6/21 11:00-11:30 PT

Thanks — happy to take this point of contact and own the registration.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: CloudRelay-Opportunity-Brief.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudrelay.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Luke Porter <luke@cloudrelay.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudRelay — AWS co-sell registration & PDM/PSM introductions

Thanks Logan — this is perfect. We're eager to get the AWS co-sell in motion. Quick answers:
- Primary ACE contact: Samira Khan (samira.khan@cloudrelay.com) — I'll accept the intake and own the internal coordination.
- Procurement: currently in SOW review with finance; legal raised a couple of redlines on our MSA (sending draft).

I've attached our MSA draft (CloudRelay-MSA-draft.pdf) — there are two clauses we expect to rework around data retention and audit rights.

Both times you suggested work for us; prefer 11:00 PT if that helps. Please go ahead and loop in AWS PDM/PSM.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, CloudRelay
samira.khan@cloudrelay.com

Attachment: CloudRelay-MSA-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 312KB)

Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CloudRelay — AWS co-sell registration & PDM/PSM introductions

Laura / Aditya / Priyom — forwarding Samira's reply and the MSA draft. Quick internal plan:
- Aditya: can you start the ACE registration packet in AWS Marketplace (answers + sizing + proposed co-sell margin) and drop a screenshot here when submitted? Owner: Aditya.
- Laura: please coordinate to get an AWS PDM/PSM intro on Wed 6/21 at 11:00 PT. If PDM can't make that slot, prioritize Carly/PSM presence. Owner: Laura.
- Priyom: FYI on deal economics and where this sits against our expansion quota; may want to prepare an intro deck for the PDM call.

Key risks to track: our standard MSA redlines vs CloudRelay's edits (see attached). Legal will likely need to negotiate data retention/audit points — escalate to CS/Legal early.

I'll set up the calendar invite once AWS confirms.

— Logan

Cc: Carly Nguyen <cnguyen@amazon.com>, psm-aws@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudRelay — AWS co-sell registration & PDM/PSM introductions

Hi all — Javier from AWS PDM here.

Thanks for the context. I can take the initial ACE intake; Carly (cc'd) will be the PSM who supports post-registration enablement. A few quick items we need prior to the intake being processed:
- Estimated first-year ARR and expected ramp profile (ballpark numbers are fine).
- Primary use cases and customers (to help with GTM assets).
- Confirmation that Redwood Redwood will be listed as the solution deliverable and that CloudRelay will be the buyer-facing offering (we'll capture roles in the registration form).

I've opened the ACE registration ticket: https://amzn.to/ace-registration-ticket/9876 — please attach the opportunity brief and MSA draft to the ticket.

Can we do Wed 6/21 11:00 PT as proposed? If so I'll send a calendar invite and loop in a technical SME so we can triage the integration surface (networking, VPC peering, data residency controls).

Thanks,
Javier Morales
Partner Development Manager, AWS
javierm@amazon.com

All — thanks for the 11:00 PT sync earlier this week. Quick recap and next steps: 

Recap:
- AWS has opened ticket 9876 and assigned Javier (PDM) and Carly (PSM).
- CloudRelay will accept ACE intake via Samira. Procurement: SOW under review; legal redlines on data retention flagged.
- Redwood to be listed as solution provider; CloudRelay as the buyer-facing offering.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Aditya: submit ACE registration packet to AWS Marketplace and post a screenshot here. (Owner: Aditya Rao)
- Laura: coordinate legal sync between CloudRelay and Redwood legal to triage MSA redlines. (Owner: Laura Bennett)
